title: aegilops triuncialis f. flavescens
intro: Aegilops triuncialis f. flavescens, commonly known as yellow spelt, is a type of wild cereal grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. Yellow spelt is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving gut health due to its prebiotic properties. The therapeutic actions of Aegilops triuncialis f. flavescens are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory agent. The bioactive constituents of yellow spelt include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
